name: Cobscook Bay State Park
waterfront_evidence: Audited 2026-06-18 (kept bayfront; pin moved from 44.8404,-67.1500 ~1.2km S onto the Whiting Bay camping loop). Tidal-bay canopy case. Official Maine BPL per-site map: the Whiting Bay Camping Area is large drive-in sites (U >35' / X 35', electric & water) on a peninsula in Whiting Bay, loops winding around headlands. Multiple sources confirm 'some larger RV sites are on the water' with direct water access / dozens of waterfront sites (drive-in site 6 cited as a waterfront site). Satellite shows loops hard against the bay shore. Huge low-tide mudflats don't downgrade (measure to high-water bay edge). Premier Broad Cove/Cobscook Point waterfront sites are walk-in tent.
note: Recommended by Grok as one of the best campgrounds in Maine.  Many campsites are lakefront.  --AWH  RV Life 4*/$$ (auto 6/2026). --Claude  Waterfront-audited 2026-06-18: it's a tidal BAY (bayfront, not lakefront). Whiting Bay Camping Area = large drive-in RV sites (U/X, electric & water) on the bay with direct water access; Broad Cove/Cobscook Point premier waterfront sites are walk-in tent. Big tidal range -> wide mudflats at low tide. Pin moved onto the Whiting Bay loop. --Claude

name: Sebago Lake State Park

waterfront_evidence: satellite at 40.1867,-107.0862: camp loop set back NE of drawn-down reservoir across open ground (>50m), reservoir visible; FS page: 'some campsites offer a beautiful view of Chapman Reservoir'
note: Primitive Routt NF campground at Chapman Reservoir off the Flat Tops Trail Scenic Byway west of Yampa, reached via FR 16/FR 940 (2WD, typically open Memorial Day to mid-October). 12 first-come, first-served sites, $20/night cash or check only; 22-ft max trailer length (a 23-ft Class C fits marginally), vault toilet, camp host on site in summer, NO potable water (bring your own). Elevation ~9,300 ft. --Claude

name: Dry Lake Campground
inclusion_evidence: recreation.gov per-site API (10168487) post-2024 rebuild: sites 9-22 max vehicle 58-92 ft, gravel Drive In; access good to campground (rough stretch is past it) -> real RV campground (old FS '20 ft' text is pre-renovation)
waterfront_evidence: FS page: despite name, 'no water available' and no actual lake; satellite shows snow-covered meadow/dry basin, no water body at 40.5358,-106.7820
note: Routt NF campground on lower Buffalo Pass Rd about 8 mi NE of Steamboat Springs; rebuilt and expanded in 2024 from 8 to 23 sites (reopened 2025). For 2026 a majority of sites are reservable on Recreation.gov (~June 15) with the rest first-come, first-served; ~$26 standard/$50 double. Vault toilets, bear boxes, no potable water; open late June into October. The access road is good up to the campground (the rough/4WD stretch is past it toward Buffalo Pass). 'Dry Lake' is a shallow seasonal puddle, not a real water feature. --Claude

name: Freeman Reservoir Campground
waterfront_evidence: waterfront 'lakeview' assessed in commit ce15c1c (Add 7 CO Routt NF campgrounds (North Park/Steamboat/Yampa)); on-water value recorded at that commit (no separate per-entry evidence string)
note: 18 sites (pull-through + back-in), max RV ~25 ft so a 23-ft rig fits but sites run small; vault toilets, no hookups. FCFS, exact cash/check only, NOT on recreation.gov; open ~mid-June through Oct (weather dependent). Access is 8.5 mi of maintained gravel/dirt off Hwy 13 / Moffat CR 11 (steep/washboard in spots, fine for a careful Class C). Reservoir (non-motorized boating only) and boat ramp/picnic area are a separate facility at the lake; most sites are set back in meadow/forest, one loop has lake views. Forest Service resumes management in June 2026 (formerly run by Moffat County). General campground that also offers horse corrals. --Claude

name: Hidden Lakes Campground
inclusion_evidence: FS r02/mbrtb page: 9 sites, MAX TRAILER LENGTH 50 ft, maintained FR 20 (no 4WD/high-clearance warning), 'Site Open' -> drive-in RV campground
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 40.5069,-106.6079: small loop set back behind treeline NW of central Hidden Lake; sandy beach apron at lake's NW shore with spur access, but RV pads are tree-screened, not confirmed at waterline; FCFS, no rec.gov per-site map
note: Small 9-site campground at ~9,100 ft on a small lake near Buffalo Pass; 3 sites are RV-capable. FCFS, $20/night cash or check; vault toilet, no potable water, no trash (pack it out). Open ~mid-June to mid-Oct (weather). Official FS page lists trailers up to 50 ft and gives no high-clearance warning; a reviewer reached it in a 2WD car. Access: CR 24 west of Hebron to Forest Road 60, then FR 20 south ~6 mi (forest gravel). Satellite shows the loop set back ~30-50 m from the lake in thinned forest, not on the shoreline. --Claude

name: Deer Creek Campground (Bailey)

waterfront_evidence: canopy-blind satellite at 39.5080,-105.5536 (dense forest creek bottom, pads unresolvable); rec.gov agency statement: 'Deer Creek and Camp Creek meet to run next to the campground' in narrow forested creek bottom
note: Heavily wooded Pike NF campground at ~9,170 ft near Bailey where Deer Creek and Camp Creek meet. 13 single sites, RVs up to 30 ft; no hookups, no potable water, vault toilets. First-come, first-served only (pay on-site, including Scan & Pay via the Recreation.gov app) - not reservable. --Claude

inclusion_evidence: recreation.gov per-site list (233185): 25 sites, 12 of 17 detailed sites max 35-55 ft (5 cap at 20 ft), reservable, operating -> RV campground fitting 23-ft

name: Jefferson Creek Campground
inclusion_evidence: recreation.gov (233723): ~17 sites, Standard Nonelectric + Tent-Only, max RV length 25 ft, reservable & operating -> real drive-in RV campground
waterfront_evidence: canopy satellite at 39.4353,-105.8538: loops on forested ridge/bench above creek; rec.gov: campground 'extends along a ridge looking over Jefferson Creek' (overlook, not shoreline access)

Reservable on Recreation.gov (unreserved sites go walk-up); $11 one-time rec-area entrance fee; mid-May to mid-October. Access via graded but bumpy dirt CR-37 (passenger-car/RV passable, not 4WD). --Claude

name: Lodgepole Campground (Jefferson)
inclusion_evidence: recreation.gov 232301: 34 sites, RVs permitted, max RV length 30 ft, gravel CR-35/37 access -> real drive-in RV campground
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 39.4218,-105.8425: loops in forest WEST of road; Jefferson Creek meanders through wide willow-marsh meadow east of the road, pads set back 100m+ behind road+marsh, no open apron; rec.gov lists no shoreline sites ('creekside' is marketing prose)
note: Largest of the Jefferson Lake Recreation Area campgrounds (~9,900 ft) in a valley along Jefferson Creek, 4 miles north of Jefferson. 34 sites, parking spurs 20-40 ft, max RV length 30 ft; no hookups, drinking water, vault toilets. Reservable on Recreation.gov; $11 one-time rec-area entrance fee; mid-May to mid-October. Access via graded dirt CR-37 (bumpy but passenger-car/RV passable, not 4WD); tight maneuvering reported for larger rigs. --Claude

name: Timberline Campground (Kenosha)

Reservable on Recreation.gov; access is rutted gravel but passable in a passenger car, not 4WD. --Claude

name: Michigan Creek Campground

waterfront_evidence: satellite at 39.4108,-105.8835: loop sits in forest/clearing above Michigan Creek's marshy bottomland; creek channel winds through willow-marsh well below/south of pads, no open walkable apron within 50m
note: 12-site drive-in USFS campground about 4 miles NW of Jefferson off CR 35/CR 54 at 10,100 ft, max trailer length 25 ft. FCFS only ($22/night) - no reservations; pay on-site via Recreation.gov Scan and Pay. Vault toilets, tables, fire rings; no potable water or trash service. Open mid-May to mid-October, weather dependent. --Claude

name: Aspen Campground (Jefferson)
inclusion_evidence: recreation.gov 233710: 12 sites single loop, RVs permitted (one RV per site); note cites max trailer 25 ft -> drive-in RV campground
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 39.4250,-105.8408: loops in forest west of road; Jefferson Creek's willow-marsh meadow east of road, pads set back behind road+marsh, no shoreline apron

Gravel parking aprons fit two vehicles, max trailer length 25 ft. Reservable on recreation.gov (up to 5 days out; unreserved sites become FCFS walk-ups); $11 rec-area entry fee per stay applies. Vault toilets and a hand-pump water well; open mid-May to mid-October. --Claude

name: Devil's Head Campground
inclusion_evidence: USFS psicc + site listings: RVs permitted up to 30 ft (sites 4-12 ex 7/11 take 22 ft), 21 sites, graded Rampart Range Rd 2WD-passable -> fits 23-ft rig at larger sites
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 39.2718,-105.1054: dense conifer forest on a ridge, no lake/creek/water of any kind near the loops
note: 21-site drive-in USFS campground in two loops at ~8,800 ft on the Rampart Range, at the base of Devil's Head and its fire-tower trail. Sites take RVs up to 30 ft; vault toilets and a hand water pump (no potable hookups, no dump). FCFS only -- no advance reservations; pay on-site via the rec.gov Scan-and-Pay QR. Reached via ~20 mi of graded gravel Rampart Range Rd (2WD-passable, no 4WD needed), open ~late May to late September, road closed by Dec 1. The creekside lower loop near Jackson Creek has been closed pending sediment removal; the upper loop is a dry forested ridge. --Claude

name: Coffee Pot Spring Campground
inclusion_evidence: Search of WRNF/campingroadtrip: max RV length 35 ft, level driveways accommodate RVs, FDR 600 narrow gravel but 2WD-passable (no 4WD) -> drive-in RV campground
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 39.6761,-107.2033: small forest-edge loop beside a dry high-mountain park; only a thin spring/ditch line in the meadow, no water body (Deep Lake is miles away)
note: Small USFS campground (~10 sites) on a south-facing aspen/spruce slope at about 10,100 ft, roughly 16 miles up Coffee Pot Road (FDR 600) from the Dotsero exit off I-70. Sites have level gravel driveways that accommodate RVs/trailers up to about 30 ft; picnic tables, fire rings, vault toilets, and no potable water. FCFS, no reservations; access is via a long, narrow one-lane gravel road (drive slowly), but it is passable for a 23-ft rig. Season roughly mid-summer through early fall. --Claude

name: Homestake Valley Campground
inclusion_evidence: USFS whiteriver page: 44 single + 2 group sites, some sites RV-accessible, dirt FDR 703 (no 4WD; rough pitch is past campground) -> drive-in RV campground (RV-capable at some sites)
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 39.4727,-106.3664: loop on forested bench EAST of road; Homestake Creek meanders through broad willow-marsh meadow 150m+ west, pads set back, no open apron to channel; agency page notes no creekside access
note: Designated-site Forest Service campground (44 single + 2 group sites, formerly the informal Blodgett/Homestake established-dispersed sites) spread along the lower gravel of Homestake Road (FSR 703) and Missouri Creek Road southwest of Red Cliff, overlooking Homestake Creek at ~8,900 ft. Per the USFS some sites are RV-accessible while others fit personal vehicles only, so a 23-ft rig works at some sites but not all; no on-site restrooms or potable water, fire rings and tables. FCFS for the 2026 season (June 15-Oct 3, $20/single); about half the singles plus the group sites become reservable on recreation.gov starting 2027. The graded lower road is passable for most vehicles (the rough 4WD pitch is the last mile to the reservoir, well past the campground), but turnarounds are limited so pick an RV-capable site. --Claude

name: Marshall Park Campground

name: Thirty Mile Campground

name: North Clear Creek Campground

note: Rio Grande NF, ~2.1 mi north on FR 510 off Hwy 149 (~24.5 mi west of Creede), ~9,900 ft, adjacent to North Clear Creek (firsthand reviews put sites ~50 yd from the creek, not on the bank). 21 sites; max spur 40 ft, not all fit it. Two vault toilets, well potable water, camp host. No hookups. FCFS - not on recreation.gov. Memorial Day-Labor Day. --Claude

name: Road Canyon Campground
inclusion_evidence: USFS Rio Grande NF page: 6 units, max spur 50 ft, FCFS, drive-in RV-capable, 2026 season opens May 22 -> real RV campground
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 37.7550,-107.1927: campground loop in open meadow at head of Road Canyon Reservoir; open water ~300-400m NE across open marsh/meadow, visible and unscreened; FS page 'at the head of reservoir' in exposed meadow
note: Rio Grande NF, ~6 mi west on FR 520 off Hwy 149 (~20 mi SW of Creede), ~9,300 ft, in an open treeless meadow at the head of Road Canyon Reservoir (sites not at the shoreline; boat launch nearby). 6 units plus an undeveloped overflow area; max spur 50 ft, not all fit it. Vault toilet, no drinking water, no hookups. FCFS - cannot be reserved. Peak Memorial Day-Labor Day. --Claude

name: Rito Hondo Campground
inclusion_evidence: USFS page: dispersed drive-in camping near Rito Hondo Reservoir via FR 513, vault toilet+parking, RVs to ~31 ft reported; legitimate primitive drive-in dispersed -> keep
waterfront_evidence: FS page: 'dispersed camping away from the shore'; satellite (cloud-shadowed) shows loops SW of reservoir set back; no shoreline RV sites confirmed
note: Rio Grande NF dispersed camping area (signed 'Rito Hondo Campground') near Rito Hondo Reservoir, ~3 mi northwest on FR 513 off Hwy 149, ~10,200 ft. Designated drive-in gravel pads set back from the lake; pit toilet, no water, no hookups, no fee, FCFS. Access is ~2-3 mi of washboard gravel passable to a normal vehicle; RVs to ~31 ft reported by campers. Open range (cattle). --Claude

name: Rock Creek Campground

note: Rio Grande NF (Monte Vista RD) on Rock Creek, ~9,200 ft. 10 sites (7 dead-end spurs, 3 pull-through), spurs 20-40 ft, RVs up to ~30-35 ft though not all sites fit. Vault toilets, no potable water. FCFS, not reservable; $10/night. Access via CR 28, dirt and single-lane after 3.1 mi but passable by passenger vehicle. Some sites sit next to the creek but no per-site map/satellite confirmed a pad at the waterline. --Claude

name: Mix Lake Campground

Season roughly Memorial Day-Labor Day; forest road snow-closed Mar 15-May 15. Access point for South San Juan Wilderness. --Claude

name: Poso Campground

Season ~May 19-Nov 18. Access via gravel Carnero Creek Rd (FR 690) then FR 675; passenger-vehicle passable. No horses/pack animals in the campground. --Claude

Adjacent to the Conejos River (a short walk to the bank) and a small Spectacle Lake across the road, but no per-site map/satellite confirmed RV pads at a waterline. FCFS. --Claude

name: Storm King Campground

note: Rio Grande NF (Saguache RD) at the base of Storm King Mtn on the Middle Fork of Carnero Creek, ~9,400-9,500 ft. 6 campsites (plus 2 picnic sites), max trailer length 25 ft, vault toilet, no potable water. FCFS, not reservable; $10/night. Season ~mid-May to mid-Nov. Access via CR 41G/FR 690 over Carnero Pass - dirt, single-lane with turnouts but passable by a standard vehicle. --Claude

name: Stunner Campground

note: Rio Grande NF (Conejos Peak RD) beside the Alamosa River, ~9,700 ft, about 2 mi below Stunner Pass. 5 sites with trailer spaces, vault toilet, no potable water; free, FCFS. Season ~late May to mid-Oct. Access via dirt FR 250/255; narrow and rough in spots but reported drivable in 2WD. Alamosa River fishing here is poor due to naturally acidic water. A riverside open site exists but no per-site map/satellite confirmed a pad at the waterline. --Claude

waterfront_evidence: rec.gov + FS: campground 'meanders up a mountainside above Big Meadows Reservoir'; boat ramp is separate north-shore facility; satellite at 37.5381,-106.7965 shows sites elevated in forest 100-250m back, day-use/launch at shore only
note: Rio Grande NF, ~11 mi W of South Fork off FR 410, ~9,200 ft, in 3 loops above Big Meadows Reservoir. 42 sites (23 reservable on recreation.gov, 19 FCFS), no hookups, vault toilets, drinking water, max spur 60 ft (not all sites fit). Open Memorial Day-Labor Day; 14-day limit. Sites sit up the hillside above the reservoir, not on the shore. --Claude

name: Palisade Campground

note: Rio Grande NF, campground on Beaver Creek Rd ~4.75 mi from US-160 W of South Fork, ~8,500 ft, in two sections under ponderosa pine. 14 sites, FCFS only (not reservable), vault toilets, seasonal water, no hookups, max spur 35 ft (not all sites fit); 4 sites accessible year-round weather permitting. name: Aspen Glade Campground

note: 59 sites in Fort King & Sharpes Ferry loops, all W/E (12 full hookup), max RV ~50 ft. Reservable online via ReserveFlorida. RV Life 5★/$$.

name: Manatee Springs State Park
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 29.4870,-82.9762: camping loops (incl. Magnolia) set back behind a wide continuous forest/wetland band from the Suwannee River and spring run; only a boardwalk reaches the water
note: ~80 sites across Magnolia 1/2 and Hickory loops, max RV ~40 ft. Reservable online via ReserveFlorida. RV Life 4★/$$.

name: Florida Caverns State Park
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 30.8198,-85.2426: RV loop on upland; spring run/stream SW of loop screened by forest, no pads on a waterline; Blue Hole is a short walk
note: Blue Hole family campground: 38 sites (32 full-hookup RV + 3 walk-in tent), max RV ~32-40 ft. Separate equestrian camp is NOT this loop. Reservable online via ReserveFlorida. RV Life 4.5★/$$.

name: O'Leno State Park
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 29.9132,-82.5829: camping loops set back ~150-200m behind a continuous treeline from the Santa Fe River channel; river not visible from loop, vegetation buffer noted in lead
note: Magnolia (~27) and Dogwood (~26) loops, 30/50-amp W/E, max RV ~50 ft (narrow roads). Reservable online via ReserveFlorida. RV Life 4★/$$. Coords pinned to Magnolia loop (river-closest).

name: Blackwater River State Park
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 30.7095,-86.8765 + reviews: 30 FHU stoned pads set back ~150m behind forest; white-sand river beaches (incl. by sites 16/21) reached by on-site nature trails, not pads on the water
note: 30 gravel full-hookup sites in two loops, max RV ~50 ft. Reservable online via ReserveFlorida. RV Life 5★/$$.

name: Falling Waters State Park
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 30.7309,-85.5329: RV loop on upland pine ridge; Falling Waters Lake ~0.4 mi S at frame bottom, separated by continuous forest
note: Pine Ridge campground, 24 sites all W/E (sites 1-7,16-21 add sewer), max RV ~40 ft, 5 pull-throughs. Reservable online via ReserveFlorida. RV Life 4.5★/$$.

name: Fred Gannon Rocky Bayou State Park
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 30.5005,-86.4268 + reviews: original pin was residential/highway; campground loop fronts Rocky Bayou with sites 29-36 confirmed bayou views, but a continuous shoreline treeline screens pads (no open apron at waterline) -> bayview not bayfront
note: ~42 sites on the north shore of Rocky Bayou, max RV ~50 ft, 4 ADA. Reservable online via ReserveFlorida. RV Life 5★/$. Coord approximate — refine loop on satellite.

name: Ochlockonee River State Park
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 30.00,-84.48: campground sits in pine flatwoods ~200-300m NW of the Ochlockonee River behind a continuous treed buffer; no shoreline RV pads
note: Single Loop A, 30 full-facility 50-amp sites, max RV ~40 ft. Reservable online via ReserveFlorida. RV Life 4.5★/$$.

name: Torreya State Park
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 30.57,-84.95: small wooded campground loop on the bluff, no water near loop; Apalachicola River ~150ft below down a treed bluff (climb-down, not walk-across)
note: Weeping Ridge Loop, 30 sites (1-16 30-amp, 17-30 50-amp) all W/E, plus yurt/cabin; big-rig capable despite winding entrance. Reservable online via ReserveFlorida. RV Life 4.5★/$.

name: Ruth B. Kirby Gilchrist Blue Springs State Park
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 29.83,-82.68: RV loop sits inland in pine woods ~200m+ from the spring run, behind the day-use core; no shoreline RV sites
note: ~23 sites; 16-17 RV/tent sites with 30A electric + water, no sewer/dump, driveways ~40 ft. Distinct from Orange City's Blue Spring SP. Reservable via ReserveAmerica (parkId 284900). Spring/swim closed for construction as of late 2025; camping open. RV Life 3★/$$.

name: Santos Trailhead & Campground
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 29.10,-82.09: campground loop in dry uplands, no water body anywhere near
note: On the Marjorie Harris Carr Cross Florida Greenway (state Office of Greenways & Trails). 23 sites, W/E 30/50A, dump station, showers; big-rig capable. Reservable via ReserveAmerica (parkId 282840). RV Life 4.5★/$$.

name: Indian Lake State Forest
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 29.27,-82.05: RV sites set back in pine woods ~150m N of Indian Lake behind a treed buffer; sandy lake shore has no RV pads at the waterline
note: Florida Forest Service. 13 sites; sites 6-11 RV/Trailer with W/E hookups, plus tent sites + host. Reservable via Florida State Forests ReserveAmerica (parkId 1121200). RV Life 5★/$.

name: Sand Pond Campground (Pine Log State Forest)
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 30.43,-85.88: campsites ring the N/NW shore of Sand Pond with an open grassy/sandy apron running unobstructed to the waterline within a site-depth; FDACS confirms sites on the pond shores
note: Florida Forest Service (Florida's first state forest). 20 sites all W/E (30/50A), no sewer; dump station, showers, fishing pier. Max length ~23-42 ft. Reservable via Florida State Forests ReserveAmerica (parkId 1120116). RV Life 4.5★/$$.

name: River Road Campground (Lake George State Forest)
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 29.13,-81.50: small sandy loop in scrub flatwoods, no adjacent water; St. Johns/Lake George ~0.75mi away; ReserveAmerica flags all sites Near Water: no
note: Florida Forest Service. 10 drive-in sites, pads ~12x60 ft (tents or RVs), no hookups/dump; communal pump + portalet, bear lockers, gate-code access. Reservable via Florida State Forests ReserveAmerica (parkId 1120152), ~$9/night. RV Life unrated. May flood after heavy rain.

name: Bear Lake Campground (Blackwater River State Forest)
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 30.86,-86.83: RV pads/loops set back ~100m+ behind a treeline; the Bear Lake frontage is a day-use parking lot/boat ramp, not RV sites
note: Florida Forest Service. 39 sites; 31 RV/tent with 30/50A electric + water, 8 tent-only; max lengths 25-93 ft. Boat ramp (electric motors only). Reservable via Florida State Forests ReserveAmerica (parkId 1120101). RV Life 4.5★/$$.

name: Krul Campground (Blackwater River State Forest)
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 30.8623,-86.8522: Krul Lake shore is a day-use swim beach + dock + parking lot; RV camp loops set back uphill in forest, no pads at waterline
note: Florida Forest Service. 43 RV/tent sites, all 30/50A electric + water; max lengths 29-68 ft. Swimming dock + pier. No pets. Camping reservation required via Florida State Forests ReserveAmerica (parkId 1120113); day passes not valid for camping entry. Separate from Bear Lake (~1.3 mi away). RV Life 4.5★/$.

name: Hurricane Lake North Campground (Blackwater River State Forest)
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 30.9445,-86.7546: peninsula loop, RV pads with open unused grassy/sandy apron (~30-40m) to Hurricane Lake shore within bound; ReserveAmerica flags sites 012-016 'Near Water'
note: Florida Forest Service. ~17-18 RV/tent sites, 30/50A electric + water (a few no water); max lengths to 75 ft. Boat ramp; alligators (no swimming). Reservable via Florida State Forests ReserveAmerica (parkId 1120105). RV Life 4.5★/$$.

name: Karick Lake North Campground (Blackwater River State Forest)
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 30.8975,-86.6404: RV sites front an open grassy apron with scattered (non-screening) trees running to Karick Lake within ~30-50m; ReserveAmerica flags ~8/15 sites waterfront
note: Florida Forest Service. ~15 RV/tent sites, all 30/50A electric + water; max lengths 30-60 ft. Boat ramp + pier. Reservable via Florida State Forests ReserveAmerica (parkId 1120109). RV Life mislabeled this 'Karick Lake Upper'/'North Karick Lake'. RV Life 4.5★/$.

name: Karick Lake South Campground (Blackwater River State Forest)
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 30.8939,-86.6446: wooded peninsula loop sits behind a pine fringe along the shore (continuous-ish treed screen, no clean open apron); water visible/overlooked through trees so at least view
note: Florida Forest Service. ~14 RV/tent sites, all 30/50A electric + water; max lengths 38-65 ft. Boat ramp + pier (electric motors only). South end of Karick Lake, separate from Karick Lake North. Reservable via Florida State Forests ReserveAmerica (parkId 1120110).

name: Coldwater Equestrian Campground (Blackwater River State Forest)
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 30.8469,-86.9811: equestrian camp with stables/open paddocks, no water in frame; Coldwater Creek not adjacent to pads
note: Florida Forest Service. General drive-in RV campground that also offers equestrian facilities (horses only in corrals/trails, not at sites — non-horse RVers welcome). ~54-55 RV/tent sites + 1 tent-only, all 30/50A electric + water; max lengths 24-60 ft. Reservable via Florida State Forests ReserveAmerica (parkId 1120104). RV Life 4.5★/$$.

name: High Bluff Campground (Lake Talquin State Forest)
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 30.4617,-84.4973: dense forest atop bluff, fishing pier between camp and Lake Talquin; per-site map (lead) shows all 19 sites on interior loops, reservation system lists 'No waterfront sites'
note: Florida Forest Service. 19 tent/RV sites, driveways 24-36 ft (fits 23 ft), primitive (no hookups), vault restroom, fishing pier, boat ramp. Reservable via Florida State Forests ReserveAmerica (parkId 1120121), ~$9-16/night. RV Life 4.5★/$.

name: Cash Creek Campground (Tate's Hell State Forest)
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 29.8161,-84.8469: small loop set ~300-400m back in pine flatwoods, Cash Creek tidal channel and shared boat ramp/dock far to the NW across road and woods
note: Florida Forest Service. 13 RV/tent sites (10 electric 30/50A + water, 3 non-electric); max length 50 ft electric / 25 ft non-electric. Showers, pavilion, boat ramp + dock; recently upgraded (paved drive-in). Reservable via Florida State Forests ReserveAmerica (parkId 1121250). RV Life 4★/$.

name: County Line OHV Campground (Tate's Hell State Forest)
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 30.0113,-84.6163: upland pine flatwoods/scrub OHV area, no water anywhere in frame
note: Florida Forest Service. General drive-in RV/tent camping allowed (OHV permit applies only to riding trails, not camping). 3 sites (#19/20/21), drive-in, max lengths 72-76 ft, no hookups; vault restroom. Access roads rough but passable. Reservable via Florida State Forests ReserveAmerica (parkId 1120128). RV Life unrated.

name: Escribano Point Bayside Campground (Escribano Point WMA)
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 30.5162,-87.0069: open sandy camp clearing with structure and dock directly on East Bay shore, vehicle/dirt road leading in, unobstructed apron to waterline
note: FWC (Escribano Point Tract, Yellow River Marsh WMA). 12 primitive sites, FWC says 'suitable for tents, campers, or small RVs'; some fit a 23-ft rig (firsthand up to ~40 ft reached it). No hookups. Last ~4 mi is unpaved clay with soft spots — passable by careful 2WD in dry weather, not 4WD-required; use the hard-packed red road by Choctaw Field, ignore Google Maps routing. Free FWC permit/reservation required (WebReserv or phone). RV Life 5★/$.

name: Myakka River State Park
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 27.2452,-82.3141: campground loops sit inland in forest/burned-field, set back well over 200m from Upper Myakka Lake/river; no shoreline RV sites
note: Large FL State Park drive-in campground with 90 sites across three loops (Big Flats sites 1-26 and Old Prairie 27-48 are water/electric; Palmetto Ridge 49-90 has 42 full-hookup gravel pads). Max RV length 50 ft. Reservable online up to 11 months ahead. RV Life 4.5★/$$.

name: Livingston Creek Campground (Lake Wales Ridge State Forest)
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 27.70587,-81.44571: two small loops with pavilion set in forest with open field to south; Livingston Creek drainage screened by treeline and distant, no shoreline RV frontage
note: Florida Forest Service hunt-camp-style campground on the Arbuckle tract; 7 back-in RV/tent sites (pads 12x60 ft, Class B/C up to 32 ft), each with picnic table and fire ring. Drive-in via paved Rucks Dairy Rd; open year-round. Reservable online (ReserveAmerica/FLFS). No potable water - bring your own. RV Life unrated, $.

name: Okaloacoochee Slough State Forest - Overflow Camp
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 26.54311,-81.29368: small roadside camp clearings amid wet-prairie/slough; no open-water body with apron, slough is vegetated marsh
note: Florida Forest Service state forest. 6 drive-in gravel sites (max equipment 40 ft) off Keri Road, no hookups, generators OK; $9.09/night, reservable online up to 11 months out. RV Life 4★/$.

name: Okaloacoochee Slough State Forest - Panther Pond Primitive Campground
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 26.55361,-81.29676: camp clearing along forest road; 'Panther Pond' to NE is a vegetated marsh/cypress depression not open water, no RV pad on shoreline apron
note: Florida Forest Service state forest. 16 primitive sites (15 tent-only + site 16 RV/tent to 50 ft), drive-in via Keri Road, no hookups, fire rings/picnic tables/portable restroom; $9.09/night, reservable online. RV-fitting site available. RV Life 4★/$.

name: Dinner Island Ranch WMA - Hammock Camp
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 26.49940,-81.13083: open grassy field camp with scattered pads; small farm ponds 150m+ away across field, no shoreline frontage
note: FWC Wildlife Management Area. Hammock Camp: 17 sites under an oak hammock, 10 for tents/campers/small RVs (1 ADA), vault toilet, no other amenities; free permit required (reserve online or by phone, up to 14 days out). Gravel access road off CR 833 (short, washboardy, can get muddy after heavy rain). Best dry season Nov-Apr. RV Life 4.5★.

name: Dinner Island Ranch WMA - Kowechobe Camp
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 26.49791,-81.12956: open pasture/prairie camp with scattered pads; small pond near road junction distant from camp field, no RV site on water
note: FWC Wildlife Management Area. Kowechobe Camp: 20 sites in an open field (40x50 ft each), tents/campers/RVs; primitive, no amenities; free permit (reserve online or by phone). Easy trailer access in dry season (Nov-Apr); may flood and require 4x4 in summer. RV Life 4.5★.

name: Big Scrub Campground
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 29.0507,-81.7561: campground loops in dry scrub forest, no water within 700m frame
note: USFS Ocala NF campground in the Big Scrub uplands; 46 sites (38 standard, 8 tent-only), no hookups, tents/campers/RVs welcome, showers/restrooms/potable water. Reservable online. $20/night. 14-day stay limit. Seasonal gate hours; verify open status.

name: Lake Dorr Campground
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 29.0125,-81.6400: FS camping loop set ~350m+ west of Lake Dorr behind continuous forest; lake not in 700m camp frame; shoreline is a separate boat-ramp/swim beach
note: USFS Ocala NF campground on the NW shore of 1,760-acre Lake Dorr; 34 standard non-electric sites for tents/RVs, no hookups, boat ramp, flush toilets/showers/potable water. Reservable online. 14-day stay limit.

name: Lake Delancy West Campground
waterfront_evidence: rec.gov 10207758: dispersed tent/small-trailer sites in pine forest, no per-site shoreline flag; satellite at 29.4269,-81.7894 shows lake as low marsh/dry bed with no RV pads at a waterline
note: USFS Ocala NF OHV staging campground on the W shore of Lake Delancy; 30 sites (tent and small-trailer) along the pines, vault toilets, fire rings, bear lockers, no potable water. Reservable online; $6-10/night. Access to Ocala North OHV trail system and Florida Trail.

name: Wright Lake Campground (Apalachicola National Forest)
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 29.9994,-85.0018: RV loops sit south of Wright Lake behind a continuous treeline; only a small day-use/swim clearing touches the lake, no shoreline RV pads; rec.gov 251908 lists no waterfront sites
note: USFS drive-in campground near Sumatra; 18 nonelectric sites + 1 electric host site, accommodates any size RV, bathhouse with flush toilets and hot showers. Reservable online. Open Oct 1-May 31. RV Life 3.5★.

name: Camel Lake Campground (Apalachicola National Forest)
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 30.2771,-84.9867: RV loop overlooks Camel Lake across an open day-use beach + paved parking strip (~120-150m, lake unscreened) - water visible across open ground but developed day-use strip + distance bar on-water
note: USFS drive-in campground south of Bristol; 10 sites (5 with electric) on ~20x45 ft aprons, suitable for tents or RVs, bathhouse with warm showers and flush toilets, sandy swim beach at the day-use area. Reservable online. RV Life 4.5★.

name: Hickory Landing Campground (Apalachicola National Forest)
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 29.9888,-85.0132: RV sites in pine-forest clearings set ~60-120m back from Owl Creek behind a continuous cypress/hardwood creek-bank buffer; creekside clearing is the boat-ramp/day-use, not RV pads
note: USFS drive-in campground near Sumatra; 10 sites with picnic tables and grills among cypress stands on Owl Creek, suitable for tents or RVs (no hookups), boat ramp with trailer parking. No potable water, no restrooms. FCFS $3/night - not on recreation.gov. RV Life unrated.

name: Mack Landing Campground (Apalachicola National Forest)
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 30.0942,-84.6456: sandy RV sites set ~60-100m back from the Ochlockonee River behind a continuous wooded riverbank; riverside is the boat-ramp/day-use, no open apron from pads to water
note: USFS drive-in campground ~10 mi NW of Sopchoppy on a ridge above the Ochlockonee River; ~10 sites for tents/RVs (no hookups), picnic tables, fire rings, well water, vault toilets, concrete boat ramp. Camp host Oct-Mar. FCFS $3/night - not on recreation.gov. RV Life unrated.

name: Whitehead Landing Campground (Apalachicola National Forest)
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 30.1653,-84.6752: dense hardwood canopy over the landing, narrow tree-lined Ochlockonee tributary; pads unresolvable; FS page says sites are 'under the trees' (prose only, no per-site map/rec.gov flag) so no qualifying shoreline-pad confirmation -> default down
note: USFS drive-in campground on the Ochlockonee River; ~6 sites with picnic tables, metal fire rings, pit toilets, non-potable water spigots, concrete boat ramp. Suitable for tents or RVs (no hookups). FCFS $3/night year-round - not on recreation.gov. RV Life unrated.

name: Porter Lake Campground (Apalachicola National Forest)
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 30.1770,-84.6772: total canopy over the dirt-track landing along a narrow tree-lined river; pads unresolvable, no per-site map/rec.gov flag; reviews/'lake access' prose is forbidden as sole basis -> default down
note: USFS primitive drive-in campground on Porter Lake near the Ochlockonee River basin; a few sites with fire pits, vault toilet, water spigot. Accessible by maintained dirt road (E) / paved road (W); a reviewer fit a 23-ft Class C. FCFS, free; closed during hunting season - not on recreation.gov. RV Life unrated.

name: Ocean Pond Campground (Osceola National Forest)
waterfront_evidence: legible satellite at 30.2394,-82.4360: RV pads sit ~40-60m back from Ocean Pond behind a continuous marsh/cypress treeline screen; rec.gov has no per-site shoreline flag; FS 'lakeside access' prose forbidden as sole basis -> real vegetated buffer, not waterfront
note: USFS campground on the north shore of Ocean Pond near Olustee; 64 sites in Electric (30/50-amp + water), Water-only, and Primitive sections, large parking slips for most RVs, bathhouses with flush toilets and hot showers, boat ramp, swim beach, dump station. Reservable online. RV Life 4★.

name: Long Pine Key Campground
waterfront_evidence: legible satellite at 25.3979,-80.6570: campground loops set back in pinelands; nearest pads ~60-100m+ from the marshy Long Pine Key pond behind a brush fringe and perimeter road -> not waterfront
note: Everglades NP drive-in campground ~7 mi inside the main (Homestead) entrance off the park road; 108 drive-up sites, no hookups, flush toilets/showers/dump station. Open seasonally Nov-May. Reservable through the Flamingo Adventures / Everglades Guest Services concessioner (NOT recreation.gov), with some FCFS sites. RVs up to ~35-45 ft. RV Life 4.5★/$$.

name: Bear Island Campground (Big Cypress National Preserve)
waterfront_evidence: legible satellite at 26.18215,-81.24777: small loop on a dry hammock surrounded by open cypress prairie/marsh sheetflow, no defined waterbody with RV sites on it -> not waterfront
note: Big Cypress backcountry-unit campground at the end of ~20 mi of graded crushed-limestone Turner River Rd (passable by a normal vehicle/camper, no 4WD; washboard/dusty when dry). 40 primitive sites (1-12 year-round; 13-40 Aug 15-Apr 15), no water/hookups, pit toilets, RVs up to 50 ft. $10/night. Reservable online. Note: reported closed as of spring 2026 due to the Hilux Fire - verify reopening before relying on it.

name: Lake Eaton Campground
waterfront_evidence: FS page confirms coords 29.2532,-81.8648 and campground 'cradled by the Big Scrub' with only boat-ramp/pier lake access; satellite shows the loop set back in sand-pine scrub several hundred meters from Lake Eaton's shore (canopy-blind on pads but lake is clearly distant) -> not waterfront
note: USFS Ocala NF campground on 308-acre Lake Eaton; 14 standard non-electric primitive sites, no hookups, boat ramp/pier. Reservable online. Seasonal (roughly Oct-May/Jun). Access via FR 44 is unimproved/rutted with dips, but firsthand reports note 30+ ft rigs camp here; 14-day stay limit.

name: The Glades RV Resort, Golf & Marina
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 26.7777,-81.2288: RV loops sit inland among golf fairways; rim canal/marina well away, no pads fronting water
note: All-ages RV resort, golf course and marina on a Lake Okeechobee rim canal at Moore Haven; full-hookup sites, on-site marina/boat access to the lake. Takes nightly transient stays. RV Life 4.5 star / $$.

name: Okeechobee Landings RV Resort
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 26.7524,-80.9137: large MH/RV resort ~1mi from Lake Okeechobee; only a small interior decorative pond, sites set back
note: All-ages RV resort at Clewiston, about 1 mi from Lake Okeechobee (not on the lake); full-hookup sites, pool, clubhouse. Takes nightly transient stays. RV Life 4.5 star / $$.

name: Fisheating Creek Outpost
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 26.9374,-81.3181: RV loops inland; Fisheating Creek ~150-250m SW behind dense forest, only tent/canoe area fronts creek
note: Private concessionaire (Cape Leisure) campground in Fisheating Creek WMA at Palmdale; drive-in RV and tent sites, canoe/kayak outfitter on Fisheating Creek. Reservable online. RV Life 4.5 star / $$.

name: Wandering Oaks RV Park
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 30.6824,-87.0537: RV/MH sites in trees off road; only a dry retention pond nearby, no natural water body
note: Family/pet-friendly RV park at 6436 Robie Rd, Milton. Takes daily, weekly, and monthly stays; accommodates Class A/C, fifth wheels, and toy haulers (big-rig friendly). Reservable online via own site. RV Life 5.0 star / $$.

name: River Landing RV Park
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 30.4398,-84.9861: identifiable RV pull-through rows set back ~150m from Apalachicola slough across open grass; immediate frontage is pole barns + boat ramp, water visible
note: Small (10-site, more planned) full-hookup park at 12319 N Central St, Bristol; 30/50-amp, sewer, level rocked pads, $40-60/night. Takes short-term and extended stays (big-rig friendly). Reservable online via Campspot. Described as across from the Apalachicola River. RV Life 5.0 star / $$.

name: Lake Victor RV Park
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 30.9472,-85.8943: RV/MH units overlook Lake Victor through a wooded shore edge with private docks; visible but no open-apron waterline pads
note: 24-site full-hookup park at 1338 Dancy Landing, Westville; big-rig pull-throughs, 50-amp, pool. Open all year, transient. Full-hookup sites adjacent to a fishing lake (Lake Victor). Reservable online via RoverPass. RV Life 5.0 star / $$.

name: Simple Livin Campground
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 30.9695,-86.3049: cleared RV pad rows by road/ballfields; only a small retention pond, no lake/river adjacent
note: Full-hookup RV park at 37 Bear Bay Flats Rd, Laurel Hill; 30/50-amp, sites accommodate 34-77 ft (big-rig friendly), $30-35/night. Takes nightly/weekly/monthly. No water on site. Reservations by phone. RV Life 5.0 star / $$.

name: In The Garden RV Park
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 30.0533,-83.1612: RV park by highway; only a small cypress/stormwater pond nearby, sites not on it
note: 14 full-hookup sites (30/50-amp) at 895 E Main St (US-27), Mayo; flat with scattered trees, in town. Suwannee River is ~1 mi away, not on site. No standalone reservation site - book by phone/Facebook. RV Life 5.0 star / $.

name: Hitchin Post RV Park
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 30.7484,-85.3905: RV pads line the highway at top, set well back behind woods/open field from the center pond and small lake; no pad on water
note: General RV park (not equestrian-only) at 2492 Dilmore Rd, Cottondale; big-rig sites up to 100 ft, full 20/30/50-amp. Takes overnight and extended stays; ~$45/night, military/senior discounts. Has a private lake and two ponds for fishing. Reservable online. RV Life 4.5 star / $$.

name: Suwannee River Rendezvous Resort & Campground
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 30.0855,-83.0961: dense RV rows sit ~200m+ back from Suwannee River behind a wide forest band; riverbank holds only scattered cabins/lots, no RV pads
note: Riverside RV resort on the Suwannee River at Mayo, with RV sites, cabins, tent sites, pool complex and a natural spring; takes transient/nightly guests (daily RV rates ~$54-80). Reservable online via Campspot. Two areas: Primrose Park (family) and Key West Village (21+). Large sites (40x80+). RV Life 4.5 star / $$.

name: Rocky's Convenience Store & Campground
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 30.0857,-83.6572: RV loop sits beside a small screened retention pond with treeline between pads and water; no open apron to water
note: Roadside RV campground on US-98 at Perry (Taylor County), attached to Rocky's convenience store/cafe; ~37-40 grassy pull-through and back-in sites with full hookups (50/30/20 amp), dump station, laundry, bathhouse, plus 2 primitive tent areas. Popular overnight/scalloping-season stopover; appears FCFS/call-ahead (no online booking confirmed). Official rockyscampground.com SSL cert expired at time of vetting. RV Life 4.5 star / $$.

name: Sunset Isle RV & Yacht Club
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 29.8458,-84.6684: SW fan-loop RV pads back directly onto Apalachicola Bay tidal marsh with open grassy/sandy apron to the water edge, no treeline/road buffer
note: RV & yacht resort on Timber Island, Carrabelle, on Apalachicola Bay/Gulf with free boat slips, pier, pool, clubhouse. Mixed-use community (some RV/home lots for sale) but confirmed to accept transient/nightly travelers. 39 sites, ~27 full hookups, 50-amp, up to 50 ft. Reservation by request form/phone (no online booking). RV Life 4.5 star / $$.

name: Ingram's Marina
waterfront_evidence: satellite at corrected 30.4220,-84.6240: RV sites sit in interior loops uphill behind the marina store/buildings and treeline; Lake Talquin shore is covered boat docks, not RV pads
note: Marina, RV park and campground on Lake Talquin (354 Lois Lane, Quincy). ~50 RV sites (30/50-amp full hookups, pull-thrus) plus tent sites, RVs to ~40 ft; boat ramp, slips, fish-cleaning station, store, bait. Transient nightly stays (~$42.50/night) reservable online via CampgroundOnline. RV Life 4.5 star / $$.

name: The Captain's Hideaway
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 29.9015,-83.6294: pin sits in a rural residential lot subdivision with no visible campground and only minor wooded ponds, no significant water near; default down
note: Boutique 4-site RV campground at 15400 Fiddlers Way, Perry (Taylor County, Big Bend). Oversized secluded full-hookup sites with WiFi and a common firepit; max length ~38 ft, tent camping available; takes reservations. Small but a real drive-in RV campground with strong firsthand reviews. No standalone official website (Facebook is the operating page). RV Life 4.5 star / $$.

name: Gulf Breeze RV Park

name: Lake Mike Conner
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 31.5717,-89.6486: boat ramp/parking apron and pier at water (a use); camping road-loops set back under canopy behind treeline; no RV pads on open water apron confirmable -> default down
note: MDWFP State Fishing Lake ~5 mi west of Collins (Covington County) on 79-acre Lake Mike Conner. Back-in RV sites with 30-amp electric and water (no sewer), dump station, boat ramps, pavilions, fishing. FCFS - no reservation system; call the State Lake office. Fishing permit/license required except free-fishing days. RV Life: 4 stars, $.

name: Lake Monroe
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 33.9457,-88.5637: developed point with open ground, pier, cabin and camping loops; RV sites on open ground with water visible/unscreened (lakeview floor); immediate shore edge holds ramp/dock use so not lakefront
note: MDWFP State Fishing Lake between Aberdeen and Amory off Hwy 45 (Monroe County) on 99-acre Lake Monroe. 14 camping pads with electric/water (30-amp), kayak launch, boat ramp, two handicapped fishing piers, restrooms with showers. FCFS - no reservation system; call the State Lake office (manager Charles Mullins). Unrated on RV Life but confirmed operating via MDWFP page and 2025/2026 fishing reports. RV Life: unrated, $.

name: Lake Perry
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 31.1338,-88.9050: cleared RV pads with private docks at the waterline on the campground point (matches firsthand 'site 2 by the water'); several pads on open apron at shore
note: MDWFP State Fishing Lake 3 mi south of Beaumont off Hwy 98 (Perry County) on 125-acre Lake Perry. ~20 sites with electric/water (small concrete pads), dump station, picnic tables, fire rings, restrooms/showers, boat launch, ~0.5-mi nature trail. FCFS - no reservations. Pads are small and better for smaller rigs, but a firsthand reviewer confirmed a 23-ft rig 'fit fine'; big rigs face tight pads with sharp drop-offs. RV $22 (water/electric), primitive $17. RV Life: 4.5 stars, $.

name: Prentiss Walker Lake
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 31.8333,-89.5918: camp loop/restroom on open unused grass with lake inlets ~30-50m off and main lake ~80m; open unscreened view but pads not confirmable on apron within on-water bound -> lakeview
note: MDWFP State Fishing Lake near Mize (Smith County), formerly Lake Ross Barnett, now officially Prentiss Walker Lake. Campground has pull-through and back-in RV sites with electric/water (some full hookups), 30/50-amp, dump station, boat launch, trails, restrooms/showers. FCFS - no reservation system; call the State Lake office. Known for large bluegill/redear. This is the Smith County state lake, NOT the Ross Barnett Reservoir near Jackson. RV Life: unrated, $.

name: Lake Tom Bailey
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 32.4221,-88.5279: Northshore camp area on open mowed grass running unscreened to lake fingers; inlets ~30-40m, broad water ~80-150m; open view confirmed but shoreline pads not resolvable -> lakeview
note: MDWFP State Fishing Lake ~8 mi east of Meridian on Hwy 11 (Lauderdale County) on 182-acre Lake Tom Bailey, at 3222 Northshore Dr, Toomsuba. 22 camping pads with electric/water, dump station, drinking water, restrooms with showers, picnic tables, boat ramp, two piers. FCFS - no reservation system; call the State Lake office. Holds the state Channel Catfish record. Rates $15-22. RV Life: 4 stars, $.

name: LeFleurs Bluff State Park
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 32.330,-90.149: Mayes Lake campground tucked in bottomland forest along the oxbow with wooded/treelined shore; canopy-blind on pads, MDWFP map unreachable, no shoreline RV sites confirmable -> default down
note: MDWFP state park (Mayes Lake Campground) in the heart of Jackson. 28 RV/tent sites with water/electric hookups in a wooded setting adjacent to Mayes Lake, central dump station, bathhouse with hot showers (plus separate primitive tent sites). Reservable online (reserve.mdwfp.com). Park also has a 9-hole golf course/driving range, disc golf, nature trails, fishing. RV Life: 4 stars, $$.

name: Legion State Park
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 33.1459,-89.0394: 15-site RV loop in wooded hills; small park lake lies ~400m-1km NW, no lakeside RV pads; sites inland -> not waterfront
note: MDWFP state park. 15 RV sites with water/sewer/electric hookups, picnic tables, grills, fire rings; bathhouse with hot showers; also 2 tent sites and 5 cabins. Reservable online (MDWFP reservation system) or by phone up to 12 months ahead. RV Life: 4.5 stars, $$.

name: Leroy Percy State Park
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 33.1655,-90.9355: camp loop on semi-open ground ~40-80m E of Alligator Lake with pier and open grass to thin cypress shore fringe; sites overlook lake across open ground but no pads on waterline apron -> lakeview
note: MDWFP state park. 16 RV sites on level concrete pads with 30/50-amp electric, water, sewer; fire rings, picnic tables, grills; bathhouse with hot showers and laundry; dump station. Alligator Lake shore fishing and kayaking; 18-hole disc golf. Reservable online or by phone; some sites held FCFS. RV Life: 3 stars, $$.

name: Paul B. Johnson State Park
waterfront_evidence: legible satellite at 31.1395,-89.2425: RV loops set back ~80-120m W of Geiger Lake behind a developed shore strip (cabins, marina/dock, day-use beach+pool); only waterline structures are cabins not RV sites; open view across grass -> lakeview (overrides 'lakefront camping' marketing)
note: MDWFP state park on Geiger Lake. 125 paved RV sites, all full hookups (20/30/50-amp electric, water, sewer); paved campground roads and pads; three bathhouses with hot showers, laundry, fire rings, playground; private beach/lake swimming area. Also 25 primitive tent sites and 12 cabins. Reservable online or by phone. RV Life: 4.5 stars, $$.

name: Roosevelt State Park
waterfront_evidence: pin at 32.3175,-89.677 is the lodge/day-use complex on SE shore of Shadow Lake; camp loops canopy-blind set back just E; MDWFP 'many campsites feature views of Shadow Lake' supports lakeview, pads-at-waterline not confirmable (frontage is day-use)
note: MDWFP state park on Shadow Lake. 110 paved RV sites across two campgrounds (R.O. Hannah and recently renovated CCC), all 20/30/50-amp electric, water, sewer; bathhouses with hot showers, central dump station; picnic tables and grills. Boat launch, kayak rentals, seasonal Splash Zone pool/water slide, disc golf, trails. Reservable online or by phone. RV Life: 4.5 stars, $$.

name: Shepard State Park
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 30.3725,-88.6265: RV/camp area in interior pine woods; Lamotte Bayou tidal marsh creeks ~150-250m S behind a continuous forest band - no open-water frontage or view
note: City of Gautier park (formerly a MS state park). 38 developed campsites with water and electric (50-amp); dump station at the entrance. Boat launch with fishing pier, 8-10 mi of hiking/biking trails, 18-hole disc golf, Mississippi's longest Marshwalk along Lamotte Bayou. Reservable online or by phone. RV Life: 4.5 stars, $$$$.

name: Tippah County Lake
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 34.7938,-88.954: camp loop road set ~50-80m back from N shore behind a treeline; only a fishing pier + restroom at water; sites on slope above lake (views likely) but no pads on open shore
note: MDWFP State Fishing Lake (145-acre lake), 2.5 mi N of Ripley off MS-15. 22 RV hookup sites (power, water, picnic tables), 6 pull-thrus, max RV length 30 ft; bathhouse with showers and a dump station. Campground temporarily closed in 2026 for storm/debris cleanup after Winter Storm Fern; lake reopened to fishing/boating 5/30/2026, campground reopening date TBD - call to confirm before relying on it. RV Life: unrated, $.

name: Tishomingo State Park
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 34.6207,-88.1943: RV pads on open ground at the shoreline peninsula tip of Haynes Lake within ~15-25m of waterline; MDWFP 'each campsite provides direct access to Haynes Lake'
note: MDWFP state park on Haynes Lake. 61 paved RV/camp sites; sites 1-37 water+electric, premium sites 38-62 with 20/30/50-amp electric, water, sewer; two bathhouses with showers, central dump station, picnic tables and grills. Famous swinging bridge, waterfalls, hiking and rock features. Back-in sites; ~40 ft limit. Reservable online or by phone. RV Life: 4 stars, $$.

name: Tombigbee State Park
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 34.231,-88.6225: camp loops set back in peninsula's open grassy interior ~50-80m from Lake Lee with a shore treeline; water visible across open grass (>=view) but loops beyond ~50m on-water bound
note: MDWFP state park on 90-acre Lake Lee. 20 developed RV/tent sites, all with electric and water, 18 with sewer; primitive area, cabins, group camp. Boat launch, fishing (bass/bream/catfish), playground, disc golf, 11-mi mountain bike trail. Reservable online or by phone up to 12 months ahead. RV Life: 4.5 stars, $$.

name: Trace State Park
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 34.2535,-88.8865: camp pads/clearings on open ground at Trace Lake peninsula tips with piers, within a site-depth of the water arms; MDWFP Deer Run 18/25 & Eagle Ridge 15/27 sites 'right on the lake'
note: MDWFP state park on Trace Lake. 76 full-hookup RV sites (electric, water, sewer) across Deer Run, Eagle Ridge and Warrior Trails loops; many lakefront; picnic tables, grills, most with fire rings; three bathhouses with hot showers, laundromat, central dump station. Also 16 tent sites and cabins/cottages. Reservable online or by phone up to 12 months ahead. RV Life: 4 stars, $$.

name: Wall Doxey State Park
waterfront_evidence: canopy-blind satellite at 34.664,-89.4632 (loop above Spring Lake, pier at shore); firsthand Dyrt review 'none of the campsites are right on the water, but some are a short walk' rules out lakefront, supports lakeview
note: MDWFP state park on 60-acre spring-fed Spring Lake, ~7 mi south of Holly Springs. 64 developed campsites (Old Front + New Back loops) with water/electric hookups, picnic table, fire pit, grill; bathhouses with hot showers and a central dump station. Max RV length ~40 ft; accommodates big rigs. Reservable online via ReserveAmerica (MS state parks). RV Life: 2.5★, $

name: Blue Bluff Campground
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 33.847,-88.5315: RV pads on the peninsula tip front directly onto open water of Aberdeen Lake (Tenn-Tom navigation pool, no drawdown), no buffer
note: USACE Tenn-Tom Waterway campground on Aberdeen Lake just N of Aberdeen. 92 sites, all electric+water hookups; paved drive-in pads (max RV ~105 ft). Flush toilets, showers, dump station, laundry, beach, boat ramp. Reservable online (not at gatehouse). RV Life: 4.5 stars, $.

name: Chickasaw Hill Campground
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 34.164,-89.820: loop pads set back in clearings behind a continuous treeline along the Enid Lake shore; no open apron to the water; rec.gov lists no shoreline-flagged sites
note: USACE Vicksburg District campground on Enid Lake, N Mississippi. 53 sites, full hookups available, flush toilets; playground, interpretive trail, boat ramp at campground (sites 41-47 are tent-only electric). Reservation required; reservable online. RV Life: 4 stars, $.

name: Clear Creek Campground
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 34.4285,-89.709: canopy-blind on pads but active 19-site loop is the forested back section set behind a continuous tree band from the Sardis sandy shore; rec.gov shows no waterfront site flags
note: USACE Vicksburg District campground on Sardis Lake near Oxford. 19 reservable sites (much of original area closed), all electric+water, RVs to 65 ft; flush toilets, showers, boat launch, 13-mi mountain bike trail. Reservable online; ~$24/night. Stay limit 14 days/30. Low RV Life rating (1.5 stars) but operating USACE site, confirmed on recreation.gov. RV Life: 1.5 stars, $$.

name: DeWayne Hayes Campground
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 33.598,-88.474: RV loops set back behind a continuous ~50-80m forest band from the Columbus Lake channel; water visible for channel-side sites across the treeline screen but no open walk-across apron (navigation pool, no drawdown)
note: USACE Tenn-Tom Waterway campground on Columbus Lake. 110 sites: 100 standard electric+water (some full-hookup w/ sewer, sites 1-13 & 64-76), plus 10 tent-only walk-in; paved drive-in pads (max RV very long). Hot showers, fish-cleaning station, boat ramp, playground, ~3-mi trail. Reservable online (not at gatehouse). Stay limit 14 days. RV Life: 4.5 stars, $.

name: Dub Patton Campground
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 34.7695,-90.113: south-edge loop sites front an open unobstructed sand/grass apron to the Arkabutla high-water edge (no treeline screen/developed strip; only scattered shade trees) - drawdown exposed lakebed, measured to beach edge
note: USACE Vicksburg District campground on Arkabutla Lake, NW Mississippi. 59 family sites, all electric (30A/50A), paved drive-in pads (RVs to ~54 ft); flush toilets, showers, drinking water. Reservable online. NOTE: Arkabutla under long-term low-water dam repairs - most boat ramps closed but campground open. Stay limit 14 days/30. RV Life: 3 stars, $.

name: Hernando Point Campground
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 34.730,-90.068: loop sites front an open sandy bank/apron to the Arkabutla high-water edge with no continuous buffer; drawdown exposed lakebed, measured to beach edge
note: USACE Vicksburg District campground on the E side of Arkabutla Lake, ~5 mi S of Hernando. 83 family sites, all 50A electric + water, paved drives (RVs to ~55 ft); flush toilets, showers, group shelter. Reservable online. NOTE: Arkabutla under long-term low-water dam repairs; campground open. RV Life: 4.5 stars, $.

name: Hurricane Landing
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 34.4912,-89.586: compact loop with RVs sits at the top of an open grass/sand apron running unobstructed to the Sardis high-water beach edge; drawdown exposed lakebed, measured to beach edge
note: USACE Vicksburg District campground near the E end of Sardis Lake's south shore, ~20 min from Oxford. Intimate 15-site campground, all 50A electric + water; modern flush restroom/shower building, picnic shelter, playground. Reservable online. Stay limit 14 days/30. RV Life: 3.5 stars, $.

name: North Abutment
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 33.847,-89.776: east loop RV pads at treeline atop open unused sandy beach apron to Grenada Lake (measured to high-water/beach edge; winter drawdown does not downgrade); rec.gov page 'several campsites face the water May-Aug'
note: USACE Vicksburg District campground at the north end of Grenada Dam. 88 RV sites with parking aprons, 50-amp electric + water; sites #2-88 add sewer. Three loops, paved roads, dump stations, swim beach on a 17-acre interior pond. Reservable online. 14-day stay limit per 30 days at any one Vicksburg District campground. RV Life: 5 star, $.

name: North Graysport Campground
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 33.840,-89.609 (2km frame): loop sits inland in forest, Grenada Lake sandy shore ~400m+ south, no water-adjacent RV sites; rec.gov 'far enough inland to avoid motorboat noise'
note: USACE Vicksburg District campground near Gore Springs on the north side of Grenada Lake, set inland for a quieter site. 50 sites with water + electric; sites #1-50 add sewer. Hot showers, boat ramp, amphitheater. Reservable online ~$14/night; 2-night min on weekends, 3-night on holidays. 14-day stay limit per 30 days per Vicksburg District campground. RV Life: 4 star, $.

name: Oak Grove Campground
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 34.406,-89.798: RV sites set back across open grass from lower-lake cove (boat dock), nearest pads beyond ~50m bound with marshy shore fringe; water visible across open ground = lakeview floor; rec.gov flags no shoreline sites
note: USACE Vicksburg District campground in the main lower-lake recreation area at Sardis Lake, ~10 mi from I-55. 81 sites with 50-amp electric, water, and sewer; three restroom/shower buildings, playground, boat dock with lower-lake access. Reservable online. 14-day stay limit per 30 days per Vicksburg District campground. RV Life: 4 star, $.

name: Pat's Bluff Campground
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 34.421,-89.732: 15 RV sites set back ~150-200m in dense hardwood/pine atop bluff; continuous treeline buffer screens both access and view to Sardis Lake; rec.gov 'great views' is marketing, no per-site shoreline flag
note: Small USACE Vicksburg District campground on a wooded bluff/peninsula off MS-278 at Sardis Lake, ~10 min from Batesville. 15 sites with water + electric; flush toilets, showers, dump station, group picnic shelter, boat ramp. Reservable online. 14-day stay limit per 30 days per Vicksburg District campground. RV Life: 4 star, $.

name: Persimmon Hill Campground
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 34.136,-89.886 (legible at peninsula edge): edge RV sites at treeline front open unused grassy/sandy apron to Enid Lake high-water edge within ~50m (image is low-pool; measured to high-water/grass-sand transition, not drawn-down terraces)
note: USACE Vicksburg District campground on a wooded peninsula at Enid Lake near Oakland, twice named a Top 100 Family Campground. 72 sites with full hookups, flush toilets, playground, interpretive trail; day-use area has swim beach and two boat ramps. Reservable online. 14-day stay limit per 30 days per Vicksburg District campground. RV Life: 5 star, $.

name: Piney Grove
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 34.568,-88.327: peninsula RV loops on open grass overlook Bay Springs Lake (stable pool) but immediate frontage is a developed day-use swim beach (used strip) and treelined SE shore, nearest pads beyond ~50m on-water bound; rec.gov no per-site flag
note: Large USACE Mobile District campground on a Bay Springs Lake peninsula along the Tenn-Tom Waterway near New Site/Booneville. 141 sites with electric, impact pads, lantern posts, fire rings, picnic tables; playground, two multi-use courts, sandy swim beach. Reservable online (4 vehicles/site max; no golf carts/ATVs). Loops 2-3 (sites 55-139) close Nov 15-Mar 1. RV Life: 4.5 star, $.

name: South Abutment Campground
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 34.747,-90.133: eastern-edge RV sites front open unused sandy/grassy apron to Arkabutla Lake high-water edge within ~50-80m, scattered trees only (no continuous buffer); measured to high-water, not the dam-repair drawdown waterline
note: USACE (Vicksburg District) campground at Arkabutla Lake, 81 family sites with electric, water, flush toilets, showers, dump station; sites accommodate large RVs. Reservable online. Note: lake under extended dam-repair drawdown (low water, most boat ramps closed) but campground remains open. RV Life: 3.5 star, $$.

name: Town Creek Campground
waterfront_evidence: rec.gov facility coord (33.6083,-88.5042) is the HQ in bottomland; per-site coords cluster at 33.6131,-88.4955 ~600m N. Legible satellite: RV pads on the Tenn-Tom banks set back behind a continuous treeline fringe with a dock access point; reviews cite sites 70/83 for riverside views/barge-watching (view, not on-water apron)
note: USACE (Mobile District) campground on the Tennessee-Tombigbee Waterway near West Point, 100 sites with electric/water hookups, hot showers, three playgrounds, boat ramp, nature trail; large RV-capable sites. 10 separate tent-only primitive sites on the Kennedy Lake shore. Reservable online. RV Life: 5 star, $.

name: Twiltley Branch Campground
waterfront_evidence: pin was in town to NW; real loops on a narrow wooded peninsula at 32.4945,-88.8055 surrounded by Okatibbee Lake. Legible satellite: loop-road sites with open grassy aprons running to the shoreline within a site-depth on multiple sides; matches 'most sites sit directly on the water' lead
note: USACE (Mobile District) full-service campground at Okatibbee Lake, ~39 sites with 20/30/50-amp electric and water, crushed-gravel pads, fire rings, showers, dump station (no sewer due to flood potential), four boat ramps. Narrow curved roads can challenge very large rigs; fine for a 23-ft RV. Reservable online (no gate payment). RV Life: 4.5 star, $.

name: Wallace Creek Campground
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 34.1625,-89.8895: camp pads on wooded peninsula fingers set back behind trees on a bench above Enid Lake (Lipe's Bluff = bench); riprap shoreline, boat ramp and beach at the finger tips, not pad aprons; finger loops overlook the lake but sit atop a treed bench, not an open apron
note: USACE (Vicksburg District) campground on Enid Lake, 101 sites across three loops (Piney Woods, Lipe's Bluff, Woodpile) with full hookups, flush toilets, playground, interpretive trail, boat ramps; large RV-capable sites. Reservable online (~$24). RV Life: 5 star, $.

name: Water Valley Landing Campground
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 34.1422,-89.7633: north shoreline loop has RV pads (parked RVs) at the Enid Lake waterline with only scattered trees (no continuous screen) on an open apron within a pad-depth or two
note: USACE (Vicksburg District) campground on Enid Lake, 29 sites with full hookups, flush toilets, playground, interpretive trail, boat ramp. Reservable online. RV Life: 3.5 star, $.

name: Whitten Park Campground
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 34.2895,-88.4165: camp loops on a forested peninsula set back behind a continuous treeline from the Tenn-Tom; dock, swim beach and amphitheater at the water, RV pads screened/inland
note: USACE (Mobile District) campground on the Tennessee-Tombigbee Waterway at Fulton (a.k.a. Fulton Campground, in the Jamie L. Whitten Historical Center Park), 60 sites in three loops with electric/water, showers, dump station, three boat docks, sandy swim beach. Open Mar 1-Dec 31; Loops 2-3 (sites 20-60) closed Nov 15-Mar 1. Reservable online; 50% Access Pass discount. RV Life: 4.5 star, $.

name: Jeff Busby Campground
waterfront_evidence: ridge-top campground atop Little Mountain on the Natchez Trace Parkway; no lake or river anywhere near (inland-parkway default-down, no satellite needed)
note: Free, first-come-first-served NPS campground on the Natchez Trace Parkway (Milepost 193.1, atop Little Mountain), 18 drive-in sites (mix of pull-through and back-in), no hookups, flush toilets, drinking water, 14-day limit. Not on recreation.gov (FCFS). Note: may be temporarily closed for parkway road construction - verify before visiting. RV Life: 4.5 star, $.

name: Rocky Springs Campground
waterfront_evidence: ridge/woods campground on the Natchez Trace Parkway, not on any lake or river (inland-parkway default-down, no satellite needed)
note: NPS Natchez Trace Parkway campground at MP 54.8, 22 sites (mix of pull-through and back-in), no hookups, no showers, vault/restrooms. Free; FCFS, no reservations (not on recreation.gov for booking). Accommodates large RVs - sites fit rigs to ~55 ft incl. tow. Water can be intermittent; come self-contained. 14-day stay limit. --Claude (RV Life: 3.5 star, $)

name: Choctaw Lake Campground
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 33.27528,-89.14611: canopy-blind loop, RV pads under pine with continuous treeline between loop and Choctaw Lake (only a day-use pier/clearing reaches shore); rec.gov 232255 lists 21 std-electric sites with no shoreline flag
note: USFS Tombigbee NF campground around Choctaw Lake. ~21 sites with water + 50-amp/electric hookups, picnic table, fire ring; flush toilets, showers, drinking water, dump station. No-wake lake with swim beach and fishing pier. Sites 1-12 FCFS, sites 13-21 reservable online. $20/site ($14 + $6 hookup). --Claude (RV Life: 5 star, $)

name: Turkey Fork Recreation Area
waterfront_evidence: legible satellite at 31.33667,-88.69690: paved RV loop (dump-station layout) on the south shore with W/S-edge pull-in stalls fronting an open grass/sand apron to the waterline within ~25m, no treeline buffer; RV Life/USFS confirm 20 RV sites form a loop near the water, some overlooking the lake
note: USFS De Soto NF recreation area on the 240-acre Turkey Fork Reservoir. 20 RV sites with water + 50-amp electric, picnic tables, fire rings; 8 primitive tent sites; 3 bathhouses (flush toilets, showers), dump station, boat ramp, floating dock, two swim areas. RV sites $20/night (6 reservable online, rest FCFS); tent sites $7. --Claude (RV Life: 4.5 star, $)

name: Chewalla Lake Recreation Area
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 34.73544,-89.34177: canopy-blind N/S loops set back in pine behind a continuous shoreline treeline (only a boat ramp/day-use clearing reaches the lake); rec.gov 233375 lists 41 sites with no per-site shoreline flag
note: USFS Holly Springs NF campground on 260-acre Chewalla Lake (no-wake). 36 sites, 9 with water + electric hookups; flush toilets, showers, drinking water, dump station, sandy swim beach, 1-mile trail. Electric/RV sites $20, primitive $7. Reservable online (also QR scan-and-pay on site). --Claude (RV Life: 3.5 star, $)

name: Clear Springs Recreation Area
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 31.42620,-90.98680: canopy-blind; RVs faintly visible set back in pine behind treed shore of the ~10ac lake, no pads at waterline; rec.gov 10158683 lists 22 RV-electric sites (Loops A/B) with no shoreline flag
note: 22-site NF campground around a small spring-fed lake in the Homochitto NF. All sites have water + electric hookups; flush toilets, hot showers, RV dump station. Loop B sites are more level and better suited to larger RVs; sites fit a 23-ft rig. $20/night ($13 with federal pass). FCFS — you must arrive in person to claim a site; even-numbered sites, the pavilion, and group site are reservable online but the standard campground is first-come, first-served. RV Life: 4.5 star, $.

name: Marathon Lake Campground
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 32.20394,-89.36296: canopy-blind dense pine, pads unresolvable; firsthand Campendium reviews report site 17 backed up to the lake and site 19 close to waterfront (RV sites overlook water) but no confirmation of pads at waterline without buffer, floored at lakeview
note: 34-site NF campground on 50-acre Marathon Lake in the Bienville NF, ~15 mi SE of Forest, MS. Sites have water + 30/50-amp electric; 2 bath houses with warm showers, dump station, boat ramp, swim area, picnic shelters. Campendium reports rigs up to 38 ft have fit (a few sites run short) — fine for a 23-ft RV. $20/night ($13 senior). FCFS — arrive in person to claim a site; group pavilions reservable by phone. RV Life: 2.5 star, $.

name: Atwood Water Park
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 31.5500,-90.0860: RVs in central clearing; continuous wooded riverbank ~40-60m screens Pearl River, no open sightline from pads
note: Pearl River Basin Development District water park on the Pearl River, Monticello (Lawrence County); operated as a public regional-authority campground. 200+ sites incl. full RV hookups, primitive camping, cabins; boat ramp, 1.5-mi paved walking track, tennis courts, playgrounds. RV Life: 5★, $$.

name: Big Creek Water Park
waterfront_evidence: pin was on empty crossroads; real campground at 31.6840,-89.3385 is wooded peninsula on Big Creek Lake SW shore with RV pads/boat ramp at waterline (matches operator waterfront tier); RV ~15-20m from water with scattered trees only
note: Pat Harrison Waterway District water park on a 200-acre lake near Soso (Jones County). ~49 sites: 40 full hookups + 9 elec/water, 38 ft max RV, pull-thrus, dump, bathhouse, cabins, boat ramp/rentals. PHWD posts inland ($38) vs waterfront ($43) site rates. Reservable by phone (601-763-8555); cabins 1-800-748-9403. RV Life: 4.5★, $$.

name: Bogue Chitto Water Park
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 31.1648,-90.2770: sites in wooded tract; Bogue Chitto River screened by 150m+ of unbroken forest
note: Pearl River Basin Development District water park on the Bogue Chitto River, McComb (Pike County); 230-acre wooded tract. 81 sites: 15 full hookup + 66 elec/water, 20/30/50 amp, big-rig friendly; cabins, primitive, boat ramp, group pavilion, nature trail, bathhouses. Float/tube/canoe river. Reservable by phone (601-684-9568). RV Life: 3.5★, $.

name: Burnside Lake Water Park
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 32.8440,-89.1008: camping loop set back behind continuous treeline along Burnside oxbow; fishing pier reaches water but no shoreline RV pads
note: Neshoba County (Board of Supervisors / Philadelphia-Neshoba County Park Commission) park on Burnside Lake, a Pearl River oxbow ~5 mi NE of Philadelphia on Hwy 15. 22 improved sites, water/electric 30/50 amp, 40 ft max RV, bathhouse; boat ramp, fishing pier, pavilions, ball fields, nature trail, suspension bridge. Reservable via RoverPass. RV Life: unrated (0★), $.

name: D'Lo Water Park
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 31.9795,-89.8973: RV lot in open area well north of Strong River; river ~250m+ south behind wide forest band
